summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K containing its Report on Payments to Governments for the year ended December 31, 2025, as required under UK regulations and DTR 4.3A. The report details payments made to governments in connection with extractive activities across multiple countries. It includes basis of preparation, payment overview, and country-by-country breakdowns. There is no transaction, corporate action, or special situation involved; this is a routine annual compliance disclosure. No deal terms, prices, or strategic changes are present.
